verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a coding tool, so the axis applies. The only related evidence is Self-Hosted Machines, which moves Cloud Agent tool execution to a customer-managed worker while Cursor itself keeps running the agent loop, inference, and planning. That is adjacent worker offload, not self-hosting the core product, and nothing in the pack documents running Cursor's backend on your own infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
